summary: West kerb beside a vacant grassy block, homes only across the road.
reasons: Nearest homes about 25 m across road

drivers.seclusion: Vacant grassy lot behind the kerb; homes across the road are about 25 m off, and houses start about 60 m along on the same side.
drivers.access_and_room: Grass verge between kerb and lot looks wide enough for a van, but no tyre tracks or hard standing show.
drivers.traffic: Through collector road, traffic and motorway noise nearby.
drivers.convention: No marked parking; one car near 40 m in the QLD image, none in Esri.

flags: Steep only at the far end (71% DEM spike at the bridge); about 0.4% at the best section
sun_shade: Open to sun; tree shade to the west and south side of the lot.
cannot_judge: Whether the verge is firm enough to park on

best_section.where: west kerb of Jerrang Street on the bend, beside the vacant block
